chunks: About a man whose garment is affected by the saffron of the Ka'bah while he is in ihram, he said: "There is no harm in it, and it is pure, so do not avoid it if it touches you."

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.تَتَّقِهِ: avoid it or guard yourself from it
key_terms.زَعْفَرَانُ: saffron, the fragrant yellow substance mentioned here
key_terms.سَمَاعَةُ: Sama'ah, the narrator posing the question
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for saffron of the Ka'bah to touch the garment of a muhrim?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning saffron from the Ka'bah coming into contact with the garment of a person in ihram. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no harm in it and that it is pure, so such contact does not need to be avoided.
